An RLWE ciphertext

Source: R/schemelet.R
PolyVector.Rd

The pair {b, a} of polynomials over one large modulus that the schemelet_ functions produce and consume. The class is an opaque handle, as in openfhe-python. PolyVector() makes an empty one.

Usage

PolyVector(ptr = NULL)

switch_modulus(x, modulus)

Arguments

ptr

External pointer (internal use). NULL (default) makes an empty vector.

x

A PolyVector.

modulus

The new modulus: a string of decimal digits, or a whole number of at most 2^53.

Value

PolyVector(): an S7 object of class PolyVector, inheriting from OpenFHEObject. switch_modulus(): x, invisibly.

Details

length() gives the number of polynomials. clone() returns a copy. switch_modulus() changes the modulus of every polynomial in place, keeping the residues, and x - y subtracts two ciphertexts element by element.

schemelet_mod_switch() and switch_modulus() change the object they are given. Assigning a PolyVector to another name does not copy it; use clone() for a copy that later changes do not reach.

See also

schemelet_encrypt_coeff()
